verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a SaaS legal-services platform with an account dashboard and document storage, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents acting on many items, entities, or documents at once. Auto-filing of annual reports and the centralized dashboard are adjacent features (recurring per-business automation and a single view), not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
